text: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）前副总裁朱民在2026年清华五道口首席经济学家论坛上表示，人民币国际化将通过四大传导机制支持中国经济高质量发展：一是全球资源配置机制，强人民币使中国能以本币在全球范围配置能源、原材料、技术与资本，降低双循环相互促进的交易成本与摩擦。
text_en: Zhu Min, former deputy managing director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), said at the 2026 Tsinghua PBCSF Chief Economists Forum that RMB internationalization will support China's high-quality economic development through four major transmission mechanisms: first, the global resource allocation mechanism, in which a strong RMB enables China to allocate energy, raw materials, technology and capital globally in its own currency, reducing the transaction costs and frictions of mutual promotion of the dual circulation.
